import pixeltable as px

# Get the existing docs table
docs = px.get_table('docs')

# Create embedding column using sentence-transformers UDF
docs['content_embedding'] = px.udf.sentence_transformers('all-MiniLM-L6-v2')(docs['content'])

# Create index for nearest-neighbor search
docs.create_index('content_embedding')

# Embed the query text
query_text = 'climate change policy'
query_embedding = px.udf.sentence_transformers('all-MiniLM-L6-v2')(query_text)

# Query for 5 most similar rows, ranked from closest to farthest
results = docs.select('content').where(
    docs['content_embedding'].similarity(query_embedding) > 0
).order_by(
    docs['content_embedding'].similarity(query_embedding), reverse=True
).limit(5).collect()

# Display results
for i, row in enumerate(results, 1):
    print(f"{i}. {row['content']}")
